newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bosch to sell radio unit to Motorola.
newsitem.headline: Bosch to sell radio unit to Motorola.

text.p: German auto parts supplier Robert Bosch GmbH said Wednesday it agreed to sell its mobile radio business, with annual sales of almost $200 million, to Motorola Inc.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Bosch's mobile radio business, which makes high-technology gear for radio transmission between vehicles, has annual sales of about 330 million marks ($195 million) and employs about 1,500 workers, the company said.

Bosch said Motorola plans to use the unit to strengthen its position in Europe. The deal includes Bosch's operation in Berlin, Swiss-based Radiocom AG, as well as other locations in Germany and abroad.
The sale is part of Bosch's strategic plan to concentrate on core businesses, it said.
The deal requires approval by German regulators.
